scope: Bounded synthetic conservative stacking study; no target-scale or full-family capability claim
hypothesis: Example-dependent anchored correction with worst-group training improves fresh composite-shift accuracy by at least 2 pp over the development-selected strongest control without declared regime regressions.
group_objective: maximum of three equally sized group mean NLLs per update; deterministic torch.max subgradient; not adaptive-weight group DRO
selection: maximize minimum regime accuracy, then mean accuracy, then declared list order
interval: paired dataset-cluster percentile 95%; five independent datasets, two initializations averaged; descriptive pilot only
stopping: One frozen campaign; resource/time/nonfinite/provenance failures stop and preserve partial artifacts. No repeated confirmatory search for a positive result.
claim_falsifier: Primary practical effect or interval criterion fails, or any clean/corrupted/known-shift nonregression gate fails. Invalid provenance/numerics yields INVALID, absent execution yields NOT_EVALUATED.
